  under Copilot licensing; pitched C-suite, won org-wide pilot. Owns production engineering on the deployed
  enterprise AI chat platform (200+ users, 20+ bots). Builds the agentic layer: A2A protocol on Bedrock
  AgentCore, Strands SDK agents over MCP servers wired to HL7/FHIR. Authored AI governance framework
  (HITRUST CSF, NIST AI RMF, HIPAA). −30% ungrounded responses, −60% mean time to detection.
- Software Engineer, Rygen BioPharma (Mar 2023–Aug 2024): clinical data platform (Flask/React/PostgreSQL),
  ETL over 100K+ records/day, 0.89 AUC-ROC models in production, CI/CD with 200+ tests at 85%+ coverage.
- Data Science Intern, TreoSoft IT (2022): FP-Growth bundling engine; client rollout associated with +15% net sales.

## Flagship projects
- ScholarAgent: 7-node LangGraph corrective-RAG pipeline (router/retriever/grader/rewriter/generator/
  hallucination-check/synthesizer), +35% groundedness vs naive RAG over 10K+ papers. github.com/shinegami-2002/scholar-agent
- MCP Healthcare Server: 6 tools over 4 keyless federal APIs (openFDA, NLM, CMS, PubMed), async httpx,
  21 hermetic tests. github.com/shinegami-2002/mcp-healthcare-server
- Pruned-Network Fingerprinting (3×H100): 11 ResNet-18 configs, accuracy held within 1.48pp; CKA predicts
  shared mistakes at r=+0.95; pruning timing decodable from one image at 89.2% (chance 25%).
- Distributed Task Queue (Go): gRPC/Protobuf, Redis priority queue, effectively-once semantics, K8s HPA on
  queue depth via Prometheus. github.com/shinegami-2002/distributed-task-queue
- MiHIN platform (above) is the production flagship.
